findings.rationale: Rewrite the in_flight case. Every conflict variant places every actor at the recovery rally point before presenting the conflicting order. Waiting until a MOVE task exists changes injection timing but never tests an incompatible order while the actor is outside the arrival radius, an explicit requirement of this increment.

Rewrite the negative lifecycle assertion. It excludes immediate success but never checks acknowledgement. A MOVE task could incorrectly enter running on an incompatible ATTACK queue, then reconcile later, and this test would pass. Assert that each affected task remains unacknowledged until a compatible order is observed.

Rewrite the reconciliation case to maintain conflicting observed orders across retry windows. Recording only the first replacement per actor proves neither retry spacing nor the maximum attempt count; the existing generic retry tests exercise other paths. Assert bounded attempts, failure or cooldown on exhaustion, and no dispatch through an occupied actor or exhausted command budget.

Rewrite the conflict test to observe strategy settlement while the contradiction persists. Its guard checks action-node success only before the first replacement; it never asserts that recovery_progress stays incomplete and the hosted recovery posture remains in force while conflicting orders or tasks survive beyond the five-second settle interval.

Rewrite the compatible-order test to keep at least one actor in transit for multiple ticks. It jumps straight to arrival and checks only the injection tick, so repeated dispatch of an already compatible MOVE during travel would pass despite the explicit compatible-order preservation requirement.

findings.rationale: A conflicting recovery MOVE becomes pending, but pending point MOVEs are excluded from generic retries. Reconciliation runs only when the same action node is evaluated. If a valid pressure choice supersedes recovery while an incompatible order remains, the recovery branch is no longer evaluated. The pending task then has no retry or timeout, continues holding its actor, and can prevent the pressure branch from commanding that unit indefinitely.

Strategy refresh requests continue while recovery is executing. A stale, low-confidence, invalid, or failed refresh calls _fall_back(), releasing unfinished recovery even though no valid superseding choice or cancellation occurred. The local attack branch can then resume while recovery tasks or conflicting attack orders remain. The new indefinite recovery hold in _revalidate does not protect this error path.

facts.question: Choose Jev's strategic priority in StarCraft II. We are Protoss after a four-Gateway Zealot opening and its first attack; we can add a Cybernetics Core for Stalkers and one natural expansion, nothing more. The choice decides which macro plan, if any, gets the next reservation and the army's posture; economy, supply, production and emergency home defense always continue locally, and a plan already started continues until it completes or aborts. Fog of war hides enemies; absence of visible enemies does not imply safety. Choose only an offered option. Local code handles targets, movement, production and resources.
